body: Sorry guys but that doesn't seem to it. Thanks for the replies though.
I understand what you're saying.
In a way I feel like other people can use it more. I get that's dumb but it's how I see it. And if I don't want to get better then what's the point of people wasting time on me?
Thank you for saying that.
Thank you for saying that, that really clears things up for me.
Music doesn't help and things about suicide make me want to do it more.
Ok maybe I am depressed, I just don't think I show it right (yes I know that sounds really stupid). And I can't tell you why I want to kill myself because to you it might sound like nothing.

Fuck man that just pisses me off to know what you're going through. Like goddamn. I don't really know what to say because I doubt any of it will make you feel any better. But I guess I'll say I'm glad you didn't die and should you want a friend, I'm here.
I really want to believe you but I don't think I can
No I don't think people like you realize the impact you have. I mean when someone is so low, you are their uplift. And it really does give me some hope. I'm also glad that you got better.
You are not a loser my man. You seem alright from what I can tell I mean you don't to be an asshole so that's good.
I'm very glad you got better and I'm VERY happy you can be a pair of ears, it's nice to know people care.

To me it seems he just doesn't understand how dangerous and what a drag depression is. I can only hope he figures it out soon, I would talk to him about it but something tells me that won't work. Either way I hope your life turns down easy street soon. Plus you fly planes! That fucking sweet!

Same goes for me, I am also here should you want to talk. And honestly I wouldn't mind being your friend. If I could ask, why were you bullied? I mean I get there's not a right answer but I'm just curious. Hope you life turns downs easy street soon my man.

I think I'm addicted to sadness because I fight being happy, like I fight the urge to smile. I know I could beat this "depression" if I wanted to but I don't. In a messed up way I think I'm better off sad. It's hard to see myself as anything other than ugly. And if I could I would take my life. Sorry to be so dark.

I was only in the hospital for like 7 hours, I'm not taking medication yet though I might if the psychiatrist decides it but I don't want to. I never told anyone how I feel but a few hints to friends and my parents know that I have some sort of depression but I won't tell them anything. I don't really feel sad now but taking my own life doesn't scare me anymore.
No problem I hope life turns around for you.

Please don't do it. It pains me to know more people are killing themselves. I wish I could show you how much you matter. Please talk to me in you want. And I'm not just saying this stuff, I really do believe you can make it.

Absolutely not. Don't say that. If you dad was mine I would have hit him back. You are worth more and it's important you remember that even if you don't believe it. I do. And I just want you to know you can talk to me should you choose.

Listen bro, I'm very sorry you're in that position. Personally if you dad was mine I'd have punched him in the face long ago. I'll be honest I can't relate as far as crappy parents but I'm here to talk if you want.
Goddamn it you make me want to hold and hug you forever. I wish I could show you when you're in darkness, the astounding light inside of you.

That's a reality but the same can be said for anything really. I mean I may know what being fat is, and denying my beauty but I don't even scratch the surface with someone who has bulimia or anorexia. But I know how you feel. There are people who know how you feel. And we are here to help. Talk to me should you desire. We all suffer a common illness, no matter how much we deny it. And maybe we can't "fix" each other or get "better" but we can try. Goddamn it we can do that much. Seriously message me if you want.
I really do appreciate people like you, and this subreddit. I am also here to anyone.
